newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor prices down on speculative selling.
newsitem.headline: India castor prices down on speculative selling.

text.p: Indian castor prices fell to 1,090/1,092 rupees from 1,102/1,103 rupees on increased speculative selling, dealers said.
"Reports of the commencement of new crop arrivals in the Gujarat region triggered heavy liquidation by the bull operators," one dealer said.

He said about 700-800 bags (75 kg each) of castorseed from the new crop arrived in the markets on Monday from the Gujarat region. Groundnut oil slid further to 372/373 rupees per 10 kg from 380/382 on sustained pressure of new crop arrivals coupled with sluggish seasonal buying.
